vertical_bandwidth_hz.argument: The EO 203 manual lists a 10 MHz vertical channel and 5 MHz for high-voltage attenuator settings. The exact EO2 and its setting are not documented.

direct_input_resistance_ohm.argument: EO 203 direct input is 1 MΩ; its 10:1 accessory is listed as 10 MΩ. The EO2 probe arrangement is unspecified.

direct_input_capacitance_f.argument: EO 203 direct input is 48 pF; its 10:1 accessory is listed as 20 pF. The EO2 probe arrangement is unspecified.
